text: libsail reads a file three ways. In memory (Fasta, Stockholm, Hmm) parses every record up front: cheapest per access, bytes and records both resident. Indexed (IndexedFasta<S> etc., generic over Source; Mmap* aliases set S = MmapSource) builds the offset table in one pass and parses on every get: memory is the table alone, random access works. Streaming (index::Reader<R>) keeps no table: memory is the largest record, forward-only.
